name: Radon Number / co-VC Dimension
details: For every finite binary concept class, \(\mathrm{Rad}(\mathcal H)\geq\mathrm{coVC}(\mathcal H)\).
proof: Let the traces \(t\mathbin\triangle\{x_i\}\) for \(i\in[d]\) be a projected d-dimensional hollow star, with the centre trace t unrealizable.  Choose realizing hypotheses \(h_i\).  For a nontrivial partition \(I\sqcup J=[d]\), the version space fixing every coordinate \(x_j\), \(j\in J\), to \(t(x_j)\) contains all \(h_i\) with \(i\in I\); hence it contains the convex hull of that part.  Symmetrically, the hull of the J-part is contained in the version space fixing the I-coordinates to t.  The two version spaces have empty intersection, since their joint constraints prescribe the unrealizable trace t.  Thus the \(h_i\) are Radon independent.  Maximizing over hollow stars proves the inequality.
proof_source: Database-owned direct conversion of a hollow star into a Radon-independent set.
witness_verification: For the full cube \(2^{[n]}\), \(\mathrm{coVC}=0\) whereas \(\mathrm{Rad}=\lfloor\log_2(2n+2)\rfloor\), which is unbounded.
